description: Suggests kinds of work that might suit someone, for questions about what to do with their life or which careers fit their interests, strengths, values or past experience, e.g. 'what jobs suit someone who likes fixing things', 'careers for people who love the outdoors', 'what else can I do with my teaching experience', 'jobs for creative people that pay', 'careers that aren't just coding', 'new jobs AI is creating', 'jobs that help with climate change', 'meaningful work in health care without being a doctor', 'I'm good with people and spreadsheets, what fits'. Returns two or three emerging directions of work from OffLadder's library of 24, each with what the days contain and one small way to test it, plus a link to carry on with OffLadder's coach.
